company_chosen: The Learning Lab (The LearningLab Education Centre Pte Ltd)

identity.summary: Live Singapore private company, UEN 200102900E, incorporated 2 May 2001, registered at 101 Thomson Road, United Square; SSIC 85509.
identity.how_openserp_helped: Search returned several registry mirrors on the first query; extract read one cleanly.
identity.what_was_missing: Official ACRA record not read; mirrors only.

business_and_headcount.summary: Tuition/enrichment for ages 3+ to 18 (English, Chinese, Maths, Science); several Singapore branches (Marine Parade, United Square, Tampines, Woodlands, Jurong named by one review site). Reuters (2022) says presence in Malaysia, Thailand, Indonesia, Vietnam. Headcount ~300+ and revenue ~US$60.7M only from a search snippet of an estimator site.
business_and_headcount.what_was_missing: No reliable headcount; estimator site not extracted.

financial_performance.summary: No financials found. 2014 Advent buyout (reported ~S$300m); sale attempted from 2021 and stalled partly due to COVID hit on performance; Nov 2022 Reuters: bids up to US$500m, possibly less.
financial_performance.how_openserp_helped: Located Reuters story via news search.
financial_performance.what_was_missing: No revenue/profit filings; outcome of the sale not found.

layoffs_restructuring.summary: No layoff reports found. Employee reviews (2024) mention budget cuts, reduced bonus pool and a 'PE buyout' - unverified.
layoffs_restructuring.how_openserp_helped: One search returned only generic Singapore retrenchment pages.

culture_and_sentiment.summary: Mixed to negative. Indeed 3.0/5 (22 reviews; pay 2.4, job security/advancement 2.1, management 2.8, culture 3.2). Glassdoor snippet: 2.5/5 from 463 reviews (snippet only, page blocked). Themes: nice colleagues; weekend work, last-minute covers, hard to get leave, weak management, little progression.
culture_and_sentiment.how_openserp_helped: Indeed and Jobstreet extracted well, with review text.
culture_and_sentiment.what_was_missing: Most Jobstreet reviews are 2018-2020; Glassdoor unreadable.

pay_and_benefits.summary: No coordinator salary figure found. Indeed pay rating 2.4/5; a 2025 reviewer says not a great-paying job while older Jobstreet reviews call pay high/competitive. Fixed no-leave periods reported.
pay_and_benefits.what_was_missing: Jobstreet salary page extracted only a summary, no figures.

red_flags_and_scams.summary: No scam or regulatory action found in searches. Reviews allege leave refusals and one anonymous complaint about a director's conduct.

recent_news.summary: Latest item found is Nov 2022 sale process; 2026 items are fee reviews and a 2027 early-registration promo.

misleading_or_wrong_results: Last search's top hit was a Reddit repost of a 2021 Bloomberg story; tutorly.sg extract was mostly marketing; sgpbusiness showed a garbled 'operating for 988736400' figure; Yahoo extract omitted the article year (inferred 2022 from the Reuters URL)

verdict.reasoning: Good for identity and employee sentiment via Indeed and Jobstreet; weak for finances, headcount, pay, interview process; Glassdoor blocked.
what_else_a_job_seeker_would_need: contract terms on leave and weekend work
